definitions.explanation: Expressing something in a mild, indirect way to avoid being blunt or offensive.

examples.japanese: {婉曲|えんきょく}な{言|い}い{方|かた}をする。
examples.english: To speak in an indirect way.

examples.japanese: {婉曲|えんきょく}に{断|ことわ}った。
{婉曲|えんきょく}{表現|ひょうげん}を{使|つか}ったほうがいい。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{婉|えん} (graceful, gentle) + {曲|きょく} (curved, indirect)

USAGE IN JAPANESE COMMUNICATION:
Indirect communication is valued in Japanese culture. Using {婉曲|えんきょく}{表現|ひょうげん} (euphemisms) helps maintain harmony and avoid direct confrontation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{婉曲|えんきょく}な{言|い}い{方|かた} - indirect way of speaking
・{婉曲|えんきょく}に{断|ことわ}る - to decline indirectly
・{婉曲|えんきょく}{表現|ひょうげん} - euphemism

RELATED:
・{遠回|とおまわ}し - roundabout, indirect
・{暗示|あんじ} - hint, suggestion
・{直接的|ちょくせつてき} - direct (antonym)
